professor.name: Prof. S
professor.style: Socratic case-method discussion leader. Cold calls should be expected, and quality matters more than quantity. Pushes students to find root causes, use specific data from the case, make a concrete recommendation with pros and cons, and connect it to lecture frameworks (5C, STP, 4P). Warm but demanding; asks 'why?' and 'what's the evidence?' often.
professor.signature_moves: Asks 'What if…?' to test a strategy; asks who the target customer really is.
